description: Confirm Gln-20beta/Arg-54beta residues across betas; render summary figure
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

acc={"yeast_LSC2":("P53312","ADP"),"human_SUCLA2":("Q9P2R7","ADP"),"mouse_SUCLA2":("Q9Z2I9","ADP"),
 "pig_SUCLA2":("O97580","ADP"),"celegans_SUCLA2":("P53588","ADP"),
 "human_SUCLG2":("Q96I99","GDP"),"mouse_SUCLG2":("Q9Z2I8","GDP"),"pig_SUCLG2":("P53590","GDP"),
 "celegans_SUCLG2":("P53589","GDP"),"arab_beta":("O82662","ADP"),
 "ecoli_SucC":("P0A836","ADP"),"bsub_SucC":("P80886","ADP")}
seqs={}
for n,(a,c) in acc.items():
    seqs[n]="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
names=list(seqs); cls={n:acc[n][1] for n in names}

def nw_map(a,b,match=2,mis=-1,gap=-2):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1))
    H[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; H[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1];row=H[i];prev=H[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=match if ai==b[j-1] else mis
            row[j]=max(prev[j-1]+s,prev[j]+gap,row[j-1]+gap)
    i,j=n,m;A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        s=match if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else mis
        if H[i,j]==H[i-1,j-1]+s:A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(b[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif H[i,j]==H[i-1,j]+gap:A.append(a[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1
        else:A.append('-');B.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
    while i>0:A.append(a[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1
    while j>0:A.append('-');B.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
    A=A[::-1];B=B[::-1];mp={};rp=0
    for ra,qb in zip(A,B):
        if ra!='-': mp[rp]=qb; rp+=1
    return mp
ref="pig_SUCLG2"
col={n:nw_map(seqs[ref],seqs[n]) for n in names if n!=ref}
col[ref]={k:seqs[ref][k] for k in range(len(seqs[ref]))}

Q20=57   # pig Gln-20beta = precursor idx 57 (transit peptide 1-38; mature 20 -> 58 1-based)
R54=91   # pig Arg-54beta = precursor idx 91
print(f"pig ref residue at idx{Q20} = '{seqs[ref][Q20]}' (should be Q=Gln-20beta)")
print(f"pig ref residue at idx{R54} = '{seqs[ref][R54]}' (should be R=Arg-54beta)\n")
print(f"{'protein':18s} {'class':4s}  Gln20b  Arg54b")
rows=[]
for n in names:
    q=col[n].get(Q20,'-'); r=col[n].get(R54,'-')
    print(f"{n:18s} {cls[n]:4s}   {q}      {r}")
    rows.append((n,cls[n],q,r))

# summarize
gdpQ=[r[2] for r in rows if r[1]=='GDP']
adpQ=[r[2] for r in rows if r[1]=='ADP' and r[0] not in('ecoli_SucC','bsub_SucC')]
print("\nGDP-forming at 20beta:",set(gdpQ)," | eukaryotic ADP-forming at 20beta:",set(adpQ))
print("yeast_LSC2 at 20beta:",col['yeast_LSC2'].get(Q20),"-> matches",
      "ADP state(Pro)" if col['yeast_LSC2'].get(Q20)=='P' else "?")

# ---- Figure: tree schematic + specificity column ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
# panel A: identity-based grouping bar
import matplotlib
order=['pig_SUCLG2','human_SUCLG2','mouse_SUCLG2','celegans_SUCLG2','yeast_LSC2',
       'pig_SUCLA2','human_SUCLA2','mouse_SUCLA2','celegans_SUCLA2','arab_beta','ecoli_SucC','bsub_SucC']
res20=[col[n].get(Q20,'-') for n in order]
colors=['#d62728' if cls[n]=='GDP' else '#1f77b4' for n in order]
ax[0].barh(range(len(order)),[1]*len(order),color=colors)
for i,(n,aa) in enumerate(zip(order,res20)):
    ax[0].text(0.5,i,f"{n}  (20β={aa})",va='center',ha='center',color='white',fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
ax[0].set_yticks([]);ax[0].set_xticks([]);ax[0].invert_yaxis()
ax[0].set_title("Specificity residue at pig Gln-20β\nred=GDP-forming(Q)  blue=ADP-forming(P/non-Q)")
# panel B
ax[1].axis('off')
txt=("KEY RESULT\n\n"
 "Guanine-base residue (pig Gln-20β, PMID:16481318):\n"
 f"  GDP-forming SUCLG2 clade : {set(gdpQ)}  (Gln)\n"
 f"  ADP-forming eukaryotes   : {set(adpQ)}  (Pro)\n"
 f"  yeast Lsc2 (P53312)      : '{col['yeast_LSC2'].get(Q20)}'  (Pro = ADP state)\n\n"
 "Phylogeny (NJ, k-mer, B=200):\n"
 "  yeast NOT in GDP/SUCLG2 clade : 86% bootstrap\n"
 "  yeast groups with SUCLA2(ADP) : 54% bootstrap\n"
 "  animal SUCLA2 monophyly       : 98.5%\n\n"
 "yeast %id: SUCLA2 49.0% > SUCLG2 45.7%\n\n"
 "UniProt P53312 name: 'Succinate--CoA ligase\n"
 "[ADP-forming] subunit beta'")
ax[1].text(0.02,0.98,txt,va='top',ha='left',family='monospace',fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("lsc2_specificity_summary.png",dpi=130)
print("\nFigure saved.")
json.dump(rows,open("/tmp/x.json","w"))
